observe_emission.wire: Observe::emit_detail (HSKO version 2): closed Outcome, Disposition, DiagnosticCode and five capped u32 counters; no address; no private_project_text. One Observe per operation carries one terminal (a second use of the same emitter reports Closed on the emission, the result stays the plain one)
observe_emission.coverage_terminal_state: the worst of the three limits' check states (over_limit > indeterminate > within_warning_margin > within_limit > not_checked), so a single or black limit over its limit is not hidden by a total limit within its limit; with only the total limit declared it equals InkCoverageReport::check_state

coverage_codes.check_state.within_limit: success, no_change, no diagnostic code, counters [limits evaluated, 0, limits checked, 0, 0]
coverage_codes.check_state.within_warning_margin: same wire value as within_limit; the typed Emission::code differs
coverage_codes.check_state.not_checked: failure unavailable, rejected, MissingRead, [limits evaluated, 0, 0, 0, 0] (undeclared or disabled is never a success)
coverage_codes.refusals (CoverageError::code, zero coun: ink_limit_undeclared_is_not_a_site / ink_limit_not_finite / ink_limit_out_of_hard_bounds: validation + ValidationRejected; invalid_rule_id / invalid_page_reference / invalid_object_reference / no_coverage_pages / ink_limit_scope_mismatch / invalid_sample_resolution / sample_resolution_mismatch: validation + InvalidInput; too_many_coverage_pages / too_many_indeterminate_causes / too_many_coverage_samples / too_many_object_references / coverage_budget_exceeded: validation + BudgetExceeded; ink_limit_scope_not_evaluated: unsupported + InvalidInput

ink_edit_codes.ink_edit.no_change: success, no_change, [0, 1, 0, 1, 0] (the edited manager equals the input)
ink_edit_codes.refusals (InkError::code, [0, 1, 0, 0, 0: failure validation, rejected: invalid_ink_name -> InvalidInput; unknown_ink -> InvalidTarget; duplicate_ink -> DuplicateAddress; too_many_inks / mixed_ink_too_many_spot_inks / mixed_ink_too_many_inks / mixed_ink_group_too_large -> BudgetExceeded; every other InkError code -> ValidationRejected

observe_emission.studio_readings_unverified: the mapping of coverage states and ink refusals onto observe's closed Outcome / FailureCode / DiagnosticCode is a Studio reading: observe has no over_limit, not_checked or indeterminate vocabulary, and DiagnosticCode is a document-edit vocabulary. within_limit and within_warning_margin are indistinguishable on the wire (typed code only); over_limit and ink_limit_out_of_hard_bounds share ValidationRejected and differ by counters. A dedicated observe vocabulary for check states is an observe-owner decision, not made here
